identity.summary: Grab Holdings Ltd, Nasdaq: GRAB, HQ 3 Media Close one-north Singapore, founded 2012 as MyTeksi in Malaysia by Anthony Tan and Tan Hooi Ling, listed 2021.
identity.how_openserp_helped: Search plus Wikipedia extract and company press release.
identity.what_was_missing: No ACRA registry entry seen; operating Singapore entity name not confirmed (holding company ISIN is Cayman, KYG).

business_and_headcount.summary: Super-app: On-Demand (mobility, deliveries) and Financial Services; 8 SEA countries; 57M monthly transacting users in Q3 2026. Headcount about 11,000 (Wikipedia, 2025) to 12,660 (Revelio, June 2026, third-party estimate).
business_and_headcount.how_openserp_helped: Snippets gave headcount; Wikipedia extract gave footprint.
business_and_headcount.what_was_missing: Official headcount from the 20-F not read; sources disagree.

financial_performance.summary: FY2025 first full-year net profit; revenue $3.37B (+20%). Q3 2026 revenue $1,112M (+27%), adjusted EBITDA $237M, profit for period only $18M; FY2026 guidance raised to $4.15-4.20B revenue; $500M buyback remaining.
financial_performance.how_openserp_helped: Primary company releases found and extracted cleanly, very current.

layoffs_restructuring.summary: June 2023: about 1,000 jobs (11%) cut. Seattle office reportedly closed with it (anonymous sources). No 2025-2026 layoffs found, but absence not proven (Blind tracker page unreadable).
layoffs_restructuring.how_openserp_helped: Search found news and trackers quickly.
layoffs_restructuring.what_was_missing: Trackers (Blind, layoffsg) not readable; cannot confirm no recent cuts.

culture_and_sentiment.summary: Only aggregate numbers from snippets: Glassdoor about 3.7/5 overall (4,090+ reviews), Singapore work-life balance 3.4/5, comp and benefits 3.9/5. No review text read; Glassdoor extract failed.
culture_and_sentiment.what_was_missing: Actual review content, turnover, management feedback.

pay_and_benefits.summary: Levels.fyi Singapore SWE: G3 about S$10K/month to G6 about S$27K/month total; median S$16K/month (S$196K/yr) on the page, while the search snippet of the same site said S$14K/S$170K. Glassdoor snippet: S$80K-118K total, base S$88K. RSUs vest 25% per year over 4 years. Employee benefits list not found.
pay_and_benefits.how_openserp_helped: Several salary sources surfaced; Levels.fyi extract gave a level table.
pay_and_benefits.what_was_missing: Mid-level to G-level mapping unconfirmed; employee (not driver) benefits.

interview_and_hiring.summary: Reported process: recruiter screen, online coding test, live coding, system design, 4H values (Heart, Hunger, Honour, Humility) round, hiring manager round. Third-party guide, candidate-reported.
interview_and_hiring.how_openserp_helped: Many guides found; one extracted well.
interview_and_hiring.what_was_missing: Firsthand experiences not read; hiring red flags not checked.

red_flags_and_scams.summary: PDPC fined GrabCar S$10,000 in Sept 2020 for a data breach (fourth in two years). No recruitment scam reports found, but not directly searched.
red_flags_and_scams.what_was_missing: Recent regulatory or legal items; recruitment scam warnings.

recent_news.summary: Q3 2026 results on 3 Nov 2026. Proposed GoTo acquisition: Jan 2026 reports of a snag over Telkomsel's stake; Feb 2026 Grab reportedly denied talks; current status unclear.
recent_news.how_openserp_helped: Search surfaced both the fresh press release and the merger saga.
recent_news.what_was_missing: Outcome of the GoTo situation after March 2026.

verdict.reasoning: Strong for finances, news, pay data and interview process; weak for genuine employee sentiment because review sites are blocked or unextractable and only snippets are visible.
what_else_a_job_seeker_would_need: Read Glassdoor/Blind reviews for the target team
Ask recruiter for level and base/RSU split
Confirm GoTo merger status and any integration layoffs
